activity_private_values_check.name: activity_private_values_check
activity_private_values_check.value: "activity"."field" NOT IN ('description', 'result', 'outcome') OR ("activity"."from_value" IS NULL AND "activity"."to_value" IS NULL)

attachments_filename_check.name: attachments_filename_check
attachments_filename_check.value: length("attachments"."filename") BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND position('/' IN "attachments"."filename") = 0

tickets_wave_needs_epic.name: tickets_wave_needs_epic
tickets_wave_needs_epic.value: "tickets"."wave_id" IS NULL OR "tickets"."epic_id" IS NOT NULL

epic_resources_name_check.name: epic_resources_name_check
epic_resources_name_check.value: "epic_resources"."name" = btrim("epic_resources"."name") AND length("epic_resources"."name") <= 255 AND ("epic_resources"."kind" = 'doc' OR length("epic_resources"."name") >= 1)

epic_resources_url_check.name: epic_resources_url_check
epic_resources_url_check.value: "epic_resources"."url" IS NULL OR length("epic_resources"."url") BETWEEN 1 AND 10000

epic_resources_value_check.name: epic_resources_value_check
epic_resources_value_check.value:
("epic_resources"."kind" = 'doc' AND "epic_resources"."body" IS NOT NULL AND "epic_resources"."url" IS NULL AND "epic_resources"."blob_sha256" IS NULL AND "epic_resources"."blob_size" IS NULL AND "epic_resources"."mime" IS NULL)
				OR ("epic_resources"."kind" = 'link' AND "epic_resources"."body" IS NULL AND "epic_resources"."url" IS NOT NULL AND "epic_resources"."blob_sha256" IS NULL AND "epic_resources"."blob_size" IS NULL AND "epic_resources"."mime" IS NULL)
				OR ("epic_resources"."kind" IN ('image', 'file') AND "epic_resources"."body" IS NULL AND "epic_resources"."url" IS NULL AND "epic_resources"."blob_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "epic_resources"."blob_size" IS NOT NULL AND "epic_resources"."mime" IS NOT NULL)

flow_nodes_minutes_check.name: flow_nodes_minutes_check
flow_nodes_minutes_check.value: ("flow_nodes"."kind" = 'group' OR "flow_nodes"."minutes" IS NULL) AND ("flow_nodes"."minutes" IS NULL OR "flow_nodes"."minutes" BETWEEN 1 AND 1440)

flow_nodes_max_rounds_check.name: flow_nodes_max_rounds_check
flow_nodes_max_rounds_check.value: ("flow_nodes"."kind" = 'loop') = ("flow_nodes"."max_rounds" IS NOT NULL) AND ("flow_nodes"."max_rounds" IS NULL OR "flow_nodes"."max_rounds" BETWEEN 1 AND 50)

flow_nodes_size_check.name: flow_nodes_size_check
flow_nodes_size_check.value: ("flow_nodes"."width" IS NULL OR "flow_nodes"."width" >= 40) AND ("flow_nodes"."height" IS NULL OR "flow_nodes"."height" >= 40)

label_groups_name_check.name: label_groups_name_check
label_groups_name_check.value: "label_groups"."name" = btrim("label_groups"."name") AND length("label_groups"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND position(',' IN "label_groups"."name") = 0 AND position('/' IN "label_groups"."name") = 0 AND lower("label_groups"."name") <> 'none'

labels_name_check.name: labels_name_check
labels_name_check.value: "labels"."name" = btrim("labels"."name") AND length("labels"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND position(',' IN "labels"."name") = 0 AND position('/' IN "labels"."name") = 0 AND lower("labels"."name") <> 'none'

resource_comments_thread_check.name: resource_comments_thread_check
resource_comments_thread_check.value:
("resource_comments"."id" = "resource_comments"."thread_id" AND "resource_comments"."quote" IS NOT NULL AND "resource_comments"."prefix" IS NOT NULL AND "resource_comments"."suffix" IS NOT NULL)
				OR ("resource_comments"."id" <> "resource_comments"."thread_id" AND "resource_comments"."quote" IS NULL AND "resource_comments"."prefix" IS NULL AND "resource_comments"."suffix" IS NULL
					AND NOT "resource_comments"."text_removed" AND "resource_comments"."resolved_at" IS NULL)

resource_comments_anchor_check.name: resource_comments_anchor_check
resource_comments_anchor_check.value: "resource_comments"."quote" IS NULL OR (length("resource_comments"."quote") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length("resource_comments"."prefix") <= 32 AND length("resource_comments"."suffix") <= 32)

resource_comments_resolved_check.name: resource_comments_resolved_check
resource_comments_resolved_check.value: ("resource_comments"."resolved_at" IS NULL) = ("resource_comments"."resolved_by_name" IS NULL) AND ("resource_comments"."resolved_at" IS NULL) = ("resource_comments"."resolved_by_kind" IS NULL)
